012/**
013 * Software version string and part numbers of the application and bootloader images of one MCU, in
014 * reply to {@link CommonSoftwareInfoRequest}. The pump uses one of two layouts:
015 *
016 * <ul>
017 *   <li><b>51 bytes (Tandem Mobi).</b> Byte 0 echoes the requested MCU type. Then the app version (a
018 *   NUL-terminated string in bytes 1-17), its part number (uint32 at 18) and part revision number
019 *   (uint32 at 22), then the bootloader version (bytes 26-42), part number (43) and part revision
020 *   number (47). This is the layout Tandem's Mobi app reads, and every Mobi response captured so far
021 *   (50 of them, from Control-IQ 7.6 to Control-IQ+ 7.9 firmware, for MCU types 0 and 1) is 51 bytes.
022 *   In all of them the two version strings are equal: the 16-hex-digit software ID that history log
023 *   449 ({@code SoftwareIdHistoryLog}) also records.</li>
024 *   <li><b>60 bytes (t:slim X2).</b> No MCU byte. The app version (bytes 0-17), part number, dash
025 *   number and revision number (uint32 at 18, 22 and 26), then the bootloader version (bytes 30-46),
026 *   part number, dash number and revision number (47, 51 and 55). This is the layout the t:slim X2
027 *   t:connect app reads; no X2 response has been captured to confirm it.</li>
028 * </ul>
029 *
030 * The 51-byte layout has no dash numbers: {@link #getAppSoftwarePartDashNumber()} is 0 and
031 * {@link #getBootloaderPartDashNumber()} is null for it.
032 */
033/**
034 * Software version string and part numbers of the application and bootloader images of one MCU, in
035 * reply to {@link CommonSoftwareInfoRequest}. The pump uses one of two layouts:
036 *
037 * <ul>
038 *   <li><b>51 bytes (Tandem Mobi).</b> Byte 0 echoes the requested MCU type. Then the app version (a
039 *   NUL-terminated string in bytes 1-17), its part number (uint32 at 18) and part revision number
040 *   (uint32 at 22), then the bootloader version (bytes 26-42), part number (43) and part revision
041 *   number (47). This is the layout Tandem's Mobi app reads, and every Mobi response captured so far
042 *   (50 of them, from Control-IQ 7.6 to Control-IQ+ 7.9 firmware, for MCU types 0 and 1) is 51 bytes.
043 *   In all of them the two version strings are equal: the 16-hex-digit software ID that history log
044 *   449 ({@code SoftwareIdHistoryLog}) also records.</li>
045 *   <li><b>60 bytes (t:slim X2).</b> No MCU byte. The app version (bytes 0-17), part number, dash
046 *   number and revision number (uint32 at 18, 22 and 26), then the bootloader version (bytes 30-46),
047 *   part number, dash number and revision number (47, 51 and 55). This is the layout the t:slim X2
048 *   t:connect app reads; no X2 response has been captured to confirm it.</li>
049 * </ul>
050 *
051 * The 51-byte layout has no dash numbers: {@link #getAppSoftwarePartDashNumber()} is 0 and
052 * {@link #getBootloaderPartDashNumber()} is null for it.
053 *
054
055 *
056 * <br>
057 *
058 * Response message for {@link com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.request.currentStatus.CommonSoftwareInfoRequest}, opCode -113, size 60
059 *
060 * <br>
061 *
062 * 
063 * <table border='1'>
064 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
065 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>-113</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
066 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>size</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>60</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
067 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>variableSize</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
068 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>type</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>{@link com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.MessageType#RESPONSE}</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>

074    opCode=-113,
075    size=60, // OR 51
076    variableSize=true,

079    request=CommonSoftwareInfoRequest.class,
080    minApi=KnownApiVersion.API_FUTURE
081)
082public class CommonSoftwareInfoResponse extends Message {
083    private static final int MOBI_SIZE = 51;
084
085    private Integer mcuTypeId;
086    private String appSoftwareVersion;
087    private long appSoftwarePartNumber;
088    private long appSoftwarePartDashNumber;
089    private long appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber;
090    private String bootloaderVersion;
091    private long bootloaderPartNumber;
092    private Long bootloaderPartDashNumber;
093    private Long bootloaderPartRevisionNumber;
094    
095    public CommonSoftwareInfoResponse() {}
096
097    public CommonSoftwareInfoResponse(byte[] raw) {
098        this.cargo = raw;
099        parse(raw);
100    }
101    
102    public CommonSoftwareInfoResponse(String appSoftwareVersion, long appSoftwarePartNumber, long appSoftwarePartDashNumber, long appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber, String bootloaderVersion, long bootloaderPartNumber, long bootloaderPartDashNumber, long bootloaderPartRevisionNumber) {
103        this.cargo = buildCargo(appSoftwareVersion, appSoftwarePartNumber, appSoftwarePartDashNumber, appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber, bootloaderVersion, bootloaderPartNumber, bootloaderPartDashNumber, bootloaderPartRevisionNumber);
104        this.appSoftwareVersion = appSoftwareVersion;
105        this.appSoftwarePartNumber = appSoftwarePartNumber;
106        this.appSoftwarePartDashNumber = appSoftwarePartDashNumber;
107        this.appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber = appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber;
108        this.bootloaderVersion = bootloaderVersion;
109        this.bootloaderPartNumber = bootloaderPartNumber;
110        this.bootloaderPartDashNumber = bootloaderPartDashNumber;
111        this.bootloaderPartRevisionNumber = bootloaderPartRevisionNumber;
112        
113    }
114
115    /**
116     * Builds the 51-byte Tandem Mobi layout.
117     */
118    public CommonSoftwareInfoResponse(int mcuTypeId, String appSoftwareVersion, long appSoftwarePartNumber, long appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber, String bootloaderVersion, long bootloaderPartNumber, long bootloaderPartRevisionNumber) {
119        this.cargo = buildMobiCargo(mcuTypeId, appSoftwareVersion, appSoftwarePartNumber, appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber, bootloaderVersion, bootloaderPartNumber, bootloaderPartRevisionNumber);
120        parse(cargo);
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * @deprecated builds the t:slim X2 field order cut off after the bootloader part number, a 51-byte
125     * cargo no pump sends, which {@link #parse(byte[])} reads as the Mobi layout. Use
126     * {@link #CommonSoftwareInfoResponse(int, String, long, long, String, long, long)} for the Mobi
127     * layout or the eight-argument constructor for the t:slim X2 layout.
128     */
129    @Deprecated
130    public CommonSoftwareInfoResponse(String appSoftwareVersion, long appSoftwarePartNumber, long appSoftwarePartDashNumber, long appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber, String bootloaderVersion, long bootloaderPartNumber) {
131        this.cargo = buildCargo(appSoftwareVersion, appSoftwarePartNumber, appSoftwarePartDashNumber, appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber, bootloaderVersion, bootloaderPartNumber, null, null);
132        this.appSoftwareVersion = appSoftwareVersion;
133        this.appSoftwarePartNumber = appSoftwarePartNumber;
134        this.appSoftwarePartDashNumber = appSoftwarePartDashNumber;
135        this.appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber = appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber;
136        this.bootloaderVersion = bootloaderVersion;
137        this.bootloaderPartNumber = bootloaderPartNumber;
138        this.bootloaderPartDashNumber = null;
139        this.bootloaderPartRevisionNumber = null;
140
141    }

143    /**
144     * <table border="1">
145     * <caption>Parsed fields for CommonSoftwareInfoResponse:</caption>
146     * <tr><td><code>mcuTypeId</code></td><td><code>raw[0] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
147     * <tr><td><code>appSoftwareVersion</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readString(raw, 1, 17)</code></td></tr>
148     * <tr><td><code>appSoftwarePartNumber</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
149     * <tr><td><code>appSoftwarePartDashNumber</code></td><td><code>0</code></td></tr>
150     * <tr><td><code>appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
151     * <tr><td><code>bootloaderVersion</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readString(raw, 26, 17)</code></td></tr>
152     * <tr><td><code>bootloaderPartNumber</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 43)</code></td></tr>
153     * <tr><td><code>bootloaderPartDashNumber</code></td><td><code>null</code></td></tr>
154     * <tr><td><code>bootloaderPartRevisionNumber</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 47)</code></td></tr>
155     * </table>
156     */
157    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
158        this.cargo = raw;
159        if (raw.length == MOBI_SIZE) {
160            this.mcuTypeId = raw[0] & 0xFF;
161            this.appSoftwareVersion = Bytes.readString(raw, 1, 17);
162            this.appSoftwarePartNumber = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
163            this.appSoftwarePartDashNumber = 0;
164            this.appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
165            this.bootloaderVersion = Bytes.readString(raw, 26, 17);
166            this.bootloaderPartNumber = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 43);
167            this.bootloaderPartDashNumber = null;
168            this.bootloaderPartRevisionNumber = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 47);
169            return;
170        }
171        this.mcuTypeId = null;
172        this.appSoftwareVersion = Bytes.readString(raw, 0, 18);
173        this.appSoftwarePartNumber = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
174        this.appSoftwarePartDashNumber = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
175        this.appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 26);
176        this.bootloaderVersion = Bytes.readString(raw, 30, 17);
177        this.bootloaderPartNumber = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 47);
178        // The t:slim X2 app reads through byte 58; buildCargo writes 59 bytes.
179        if (raw.length >= 59) {
180            this.bootloaderPartDashNumber = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 51);
181            this.bootloaderPartRevisionNumber = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 55);
182        }
183        
184    }
185
186
187    public static byte[] buildMobiCargo(int mcuTypeId, String appSoftwareVersion, long appSoftwarePartNumber, long appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber, String bootloaderVersion, long bootloaderPartNumber, long bootloaderPartRevisionNumber) {
188        return Bytes.combine(
189            new byte[]{ (byte) mcuTypeId },
190            Bytes.writeString(appSoftwareVersion, 17),
191            Bytes.toUint32(appSoftwarePartNumber),
192            Bytes.toUint32(appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber),
193            Bytes.writeString(bootloaderVersion, 17),
194            Bytes.toUint32(bootloaderPartNumber),
195            Bytes.toUint32(bootloaderPartRevisionNumber));
196    }
197

255    public static byte[] buildCargo(String appSoftwareVersion, long appSoftwarePartNumber, long appSoftwareDashNumber, long appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber, String bootloaderVersion, long bootloaderPartNumber, Long bootloaderPartDashNumber, Long bootloaderPartRevisionNumber) {
256        return Bytes.combine(
257            Bytes.writeString(appSoftwareVersion, 18),
258            Bytes.toUint32(appSoftwarePartNumber), 
259            Bytes.toUint32(appSoftwareDashNumber), 
260            Bytes.toUint32(appSoftwarePartRevisionNumber), 
261            Bytes.writeString(bootloaderVersion, 17),
262            Bytes.toUint32(bootloaderPartNumber),
263                (bootloaderPartDashNumber == null && bootloaderPartRevisionNumber == null) ?
264                    new byte[0] : Bytes.combine(
265                        Bytes.toUint32(bootloaderPartDashNumber),
266                        Bytes.toUint32(bootloaderPartRevisionNumber)));
267    }
